s: Din hattoeh bitpillat shabbat ubo y"ch seipim: tzarik lomar parashat "vaykullu" bitpillat arbit. Vekol hammitpallel veomer "vaykullu" — maaleh alayv hakkatub keillu naasa shuttap lehaqqadosh baruk hu bemaaseh bereshit, shenneemar "vaykullu", al tiqre "vaykullu", ella "vaykallu", kelomar haqqadosh baruk hu vahu:

Im taa vehitchil berakot emtzaiyyot shel chol, im nizkar beemtza beraka — tzarik ligmor kol otah beraka, veachar kak matchil beraka emtzait shel shabbat, ben shennizkar bibraka rishona shel emtzaiyyot shel chol shehi atta "chonen", uben shennizkar bishar berakot emtzaiyyot shel chol, veken beyom tob, lepi shemmin haddin haya rauy letaqqen gam beshabbat veyom tob kol berakot haemtzaiyyot kemo bechol ulehazkir qedushat hayyom baaboda kemo berosh chodesh vechullo shel moed, ella shemmippene kebod shabbat veyom tob lo hitrichuhu chakamim, vetiqqennu beraka achat emtzait liqdushat hayyom, im ken zeh shehitchil berakot emtzaiyyot shel chol — yesh lo ligmor otah beraka shehitchil, kevan shehi reuya leomrah atta min haddin:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bitpillat arbit, o shacharit, o mincha, abal bemusap, im hitchil berakot emtzaiyyot shel chol — tzarik lipsoq beemtza habberaka shenizkar bah ulehatchil emtzait shel tepillat musap, lepi shebbitpillat musap lo haya rauy kelal min haddin lehitpallel kol haemtzaiyyot shel chol ella beraka achat shel musap bilbaddah, shehare ap berosh chodesh vechullo shel moed shehitrichu lehitpallel y"ch arbit shacharit umincha veap al pi ken bemusap en mitpalelin ella z' berakot, im ken en hattaam mippene hattorach ella mippene sheen tzarik yoter. Veyesh choleqin al zeh. Usepeq berakot lehaqel:

Apillu im lo hitchil ella teba achat mehabberakot emtzaiyyot shel chol shennizkar bah — tzarik ligmor et kullah. Bameh debarim amurim? Bishar kol habberakot haemtzaiyyot, chutz mibbirkat "atta chonen", sheim lo amar ella tebat "atta" bilbaddah, ap al pi shehaya mitkavven lomar "atta chonen", shehaya sabur shehu chol, venizkar qodem sheamar "chonen" — lo yigmor otah beraka, ella yomar miyyad "qiddashta et yom hashshebii ku'", im hu bearbit, veken im hu bemincha — yomar miyyad "echad veshimka echad ku'", lepi shello hitchil adayin tepillat chol bepiv, shettebat "atta" hi gam ken bitpillat shabbat. Veap shehayeta machashabto al tepillat hachol — en bekak kelum, sheen habberaka nipsedet bishbil kavvana acheret, kemo shennitbaer besimman r"t. Abal im hu bitpillat shacharit, sheen tebat "atta" beotah tepilla, im ken zeh sheamar "atta" shehaya sabur shehu chol, hare hitchil bitpillat hachol, vetzarik ligmor otah beraka, veachar kak yatchil "yismach mosheh". Abal im haya yodea shehu shabbat ella shennikshal bilshono mechamat hergelo kol yemot hachol veamar tebat "atta" venizkar qodem sheamar "chonen" — lo yigmor otah beraka, ella chozer litpillat shabbat, lepi shehare zeh kehechelip tepilla shel shabbat zo bezo, kevan sheyyodea shehu shabbat, velo amar ella tebat "atta" sheyyeshnah gam ken bitpillot hashshabbat, kegon "atta qiddashta" o "atta echad", veim haya rotzeh haya yakol lomar "qiddashta" o "echad" achar tebat "atta" sheamar, im ken lo hitchil adayin shel chol. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik lomar "qiddashta" o "echad", ella yomar miyyad "yismach mosheh", veyihyeh perush debarayv: "atta" haqqadosh baruk hu, "yismach mosheh bemattenat chelqo":
Mi shettaa vehitchil tepilla shel chol beshabbat — simman ra lo, vipashpesh bemaasayv viharher bitshuba:
Yesh nohagim mittaam hayyadua lahem lomar bearbit "veyanuchu bah", ubeshacharit umusap "veyanuchu bo", ubemincha "shabbatot qodsheka veyanuchu bam":

Mi shettaa lehitpallel kol hattepilla shel chol beshabbat velo hizkir kelal inyan qedushsha shel shabbat bitpillato — lo yatza yede chobato, vetzarik lachazor ulehitpallel tepilla shel shabbat. Abal im hizkir shel shabbat betok y"ch, ap al pi shello qaba leshabbat beraka bipne atzmah — yatza yede chobato. Ubemusap im hitpallel y"ch velo amar raq "venaaseh lepaneka et chobotenu bitmide yom ubeqorban musap" beachat mehabberakot — yatza:

Taa vehitpallel shel chol beshabbat velo hizkir shel shabbat, im aqar raglayv — tzarik lachazor lerosh bekol inyan. Veim lo aqar raglayv adayin, ap al pi shessiyyem tepillato ella shello amar adayin hattachanunim shehu ragil lomar achar tepillato, kegon "elohay netzor" — eno chozer ella litchillat beraka shel shabbat, vegomer achareha g' berakot haacharonot. Abal im kebar siyyem tachanunim — tzarik lachazor lerosh ap al pi sheadayin lo aqar raglayv:

Veim hu mesuppaq im hizkir shel shabbat bitpillat y"ch shehitpallel — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel, shemin hassetam lo hizkir, kevan sheen ken hergelo shel adam. Abal im hu mesuppaq im hitpallel tepillat y"ch shel chol o im hitpallel z' berakot shel shabbat — yesh lehistappeq im tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel:

Hattoeh bibraka emtzait shel tepillot hashshabbat vehechelip shel tepilla zo beshel tepilla haacheret shel shabbat, im nizkar qodem shessiyyem beraka zo shel tepilla haacheret — tzarik lipsoq velachazor lerosh beraka zo mittepilla shel akshav. Veim siyyem beraka zo — eno chozer, lepi sheiqqar beraka haemtzait hu "retzeh na bimnuchatenu", shehu shaveh bekol hattepillot:

Bameh debarim amurim? Bitpillat arbit shacharit umincha, abal bitpillat musap, im hitpallel bimqomah achat mishshear hattepillot — lo yatza, hoil velo hizkir qorban musap. Veken im hitpallel musap bearbit o shacharit o mincha — lo yatza, hoil vehizkir qorban musap betok tepillato veamar sheqer lipne hammaqom:

Achar tepillat lachash bearbit nohagin lachazor velomar "vaykullu", mishshum yom tob shechal lihyot beshabbat, sheen omerim oto betok hattepilla, vetzarik leomro az achar hattepilla, ukede shello lechalleq ben shabbat leshabbat nahagu leomro bekol hashshabbatot, vegam kede lehotzi et mi sheeno yodea leomro. Venohagin leomro kullam yachad beqol ram umeummad, lepi shebbezeh anu meidim lehaqqadosh baruk hu bemaaseh bereshit vehaedim tzerikim lehaid meummad. Veim shakach leomro bebet hakkeneset — tob sheyyomar oto shebbeqiddush meummad:

Tiqqenu chakamim sheachar tepillat lachash yomar hashsheliach tzibbur beraka achat meen sheba. Velamma tiqqenu belel shabbat yoter mishshear lelot shello tiqqenu chazarat sheliach tzibbur achar tepillat arbit, kemo shennitbaer hattaam besimman rl"z, lepi shebbatte kenesiyyot shebbimehem hayu bassadot sheshsham metzuyim mazziqim, vekol shear lelot hayu asuqin bimlaktan, ubegomram melaktam mitpalelim arbit bebetam velo hayu baim lebet hakkeneset ballayla, abal lel shabbat hayu baim lebet hakkeneset, vechasheshu sheyyesh sheenan memaharim labo veshohin leachar tepillat hatztzibbur veyishshaaru yechidim bebet hakkeneset veyistakkenu, lekak heeriku tepillat hatztzibbur kede sheyyihyeh penay leyachid ligmor tepillato beod shehashsheliach tzibbur omer beraka zo. Lepikak, lo tiqqenuha ella al hashsheliach tzibbur bilbad. Veim yirtzu hatztzibbur leomrah im hashsheliach tzibbur — tzarik sheyyomru belo peticha ubelo chatima, kede shello yebareku lebattala. Veken hamminhag bimdinot ellu lomar im hashsheliach tzibbur "magen abot" ad "zeker lemaaseh bereshit". Veap hammitpallel beyachid sherotzeh lomar ken — hareshut beyado:

Yom tob shechal lihyot beshabbat — eno mazkir yom tob bibraka meen sheba, lepi sheilmale shabbat en berakot meen sheba beyom tob, mippene shebberaka zo lo nitqena beshabbat biglal chobat hayyom ella mippene hammazziqin (ubelel yom tob lo hayu baim gam ken lebet hakkeneset, mippene shehayu terudim bimleket okel nepesh). Veeno domeh linila shebbeyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat shetztzarik lehazkir gam shel shabbat binila ap al pi sheen neila beshabbat, lepi shemmikkol maqom yom zeh hu nitchayyeb bearba tepillot, dehaynu shacharit musap mincha neila, vetzarik lehazkir inyan hayyom shehu shabbat bekol achat mehen, abal kan lo nitqena habberaka bishbil chobat hayyom, ella bishbil sakkanat hammazziqin:

En omerim beraka meen z' ella bebet hakkeneset qabua, dehaynu bekol maqom shemmitpalelin bo baasara biqbiut. Abal maqom shemmitpalelin bo baasara beaqray bealma, kegon otan sheosim lipraqim minyan bebetam, veken bebet chatanim vaabelim sheosim minyan bebetam — en lomar sham birkat meen z', dekevan sheen sham minyan qabua — lo shayyak hattaam bishbil sheyyesayyemu tepillatam hamacharim labo. Veap al pi sheakshav shebbatte kenesiyyot shellanu beyishshub lo shayyak kelal taam zeh, ella shettaqqanat chakamim lo botla ap al pi shebbatel hattaam shebbiglalo tiqqenu, mikkol maqom bekol maqom sheen sham minyan qabua — lo tiqqenu bo chakamim meolam. Veim qobeim maqom lehitpallel bo baasara ezeh zeman, kegon biridin shergilim liqboa maqom al kamma shabuot — yesh mi shehora leomrah sham, sheggam sham yesh hamacharin labo. Ubemaqom shennahagu leomrah ap beminyan shehu beaqray bealma — en limchot beyadam (kevan shello nizkar dabar zeh bigmara ubedibre haggeonim):
Ap beshabbat sheachar yom tob omerim beraka meen z', ap al pi sheaz eno matzuy kol kak hamacharim labo kemo bishar arbe shabbatot, shehem yom chol umitasseqin bahem bimlaka ad haereb:

Maaseh bechasid echad sheraa bachalomo chasid acher upanayv moriqot, amar lo lamma paneka moriqot? Amar lo mippene shehayiti medabber beshaa shehatztzibbur hayu omerim "vaykullu" velo amarti immahem beyachad, vegam mippene shehayiti medabber beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur haya omer beraka meen z' ubeshaa shehaya omer "yitgaddal" ad "amen yehe shemeh rabba", velo hitteti oznay lishmoa mimmennu bekavvana. Al ken yesh lizzaher:

Im taa vehitpallel tepilla shel chol belel shabbat, o apillu lo hitpallel kelal, im shama beraka meen z' mehashsheliach tzibbur merosh vead sop — yatza yede chobato. Veap al pi shebbishar tepillot en hashsheliach tzibbur motzi ella et mi sheeno baqi abal lo et habbaqi, mikkol maqom bitpillat arbit shehi reshut — heqellu bah, ulekak yotze gam ken bemeen z' bimqom z'. Vetob sheyyomrenna im hashsheliach tzibbur kesheyyotze bah yede chobato. Abal im kebar amarah sheliach tzibbur — asur leyachid leomrah kede latzet bah yede chobato, lepi shello nitqena ella betzibbur. Umikkol maqom, im abar vaamarah beyachid — yatza yede chobato, hoil utepillat arbit reshut:
